reports.title: Maze Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Highlights

desk.headline: Loss widens to $0.79/share as trials scale up; $477m cash, runway into 2029; full HORIZON data due early 2027

other.label: License revenue (9 months)
other.change: Shionogi milestone in Q1; none in Q3

results: Maze is a clinical-stage drug developer with no product sales; it booked no revenue in the quarter.
Net loss grew to $48.0m ($0.79 a share) from $30.1m, slightly wider than the $0.75 analysts expected.
R&D spending rose 60% to $40.2m as the MZE829 and MZE782 trials advanced; G&A rose to $11.3m.
Enrolment in the Phase 2 HORIZON trial of MZE829 (APOL1 kidney disease) closed with more than 50 patients, above the target.
Cash and securities stood at $477.0m, up from $360.0m at the end of 2025.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance, as usual for a clinical-stage biotech. Maze says its cash should fund operations into 2029 and lists trial milestones instead.

items.new: All three cohorts; pivotal trial planned H1 2027
PKU Phase 2 topline in 2027; CKD Phase 2 start H1 2027

watch: Full HORIZON results for MZE829 across the three patient groups in early 2027.
Regulator feedback and the start of a pivotal MZE829 trial in H1 2027.
Enrolment in the MZE782 PKU trial and the CKD trial start.
